items.zh: 刚扫了你二维码，通过一下呗？
items.scene: 刚加完微信，对方一直没通过

answers.en: I just scanned your QR code — can you accept my request?
answers.note: 最直接，先把动作讲清再提请求，适合发消息催一下。

answers.en: Just sent you a friend request — no rush, whenever you see it.
answers.note: no rush 主动给对方留时间，语气客气，适合不太熟或对方正忙。

answers.en: Sent you a request — accept when you get a sec.
answers.note: get a sec 很口语，把催促藏在随意里，适合关系近的人。

items.zh: 群里有个人挺聊得来，我要不要加他微信？
items.scene: 跟朋友商量要不要主动加群友

answers.en: There's this guy in the group I get along with — should I add him on WeChat?
answers.note: 先交代缘由再问建议，信息最全，适合找朋友拿主意。

answers.en: Should I just add him? We've been chatting a lot in the group.
answers.note: 先问再加理由，just 显出已经想加，只差朋友推一把。

answers.en: Is it weird if I add someone from the group?
answers.note: 问的是合不合适，带顾虑，适合怕被当成推销或搭讪。

items.zh: 你微信号多少？我手机号搜不到你。
items.scene: 同事换了号码，微信搜不到人

answers.en: What's your WeChat ID? Your phone number isn't coming up.
answers.note: 先问 ID 再说搜不到的原因，信息完整，适合办公场合。

answers.en: I can't find you by phone — what's your WeChat ID?
answers.note: 先讲问题再问，像边操作手机边说话，语气随意。

answers.en: Your number's not linked to your WeChat, is it? What's your ID?
answers.note: 用反问确认号码没绑定，语气熟络，适合关系不错的同事。

items.zh: 我把咱们几个拉个群吧，方便约饭。
items.scene: 同学聚会后想建个小群

answers.en: Let me start a group chat so we can figure out dinner.
answers.note: Let me 主动揽下这件事，最常用，适合当场就建群。

answers.en: Should I put us all in a group? Easier for planning.
answers.note: 用问句征求意见，不替别人做主，适合关系一般。

answers.en: I'll just make a group chat — planning's way easier that way.
answers.note: I'll just 直接拍板，语气干脆，适合大家已经很熟。

items.zh: 这个通知要不要在群里@所有人？
items.scene: 发重要通知前先问同事

answers.en: Should I @everyone for this notice?
answers.note: 最短，直接问操作，适合跟平级同事确认一句。

answers.en: Do you think this is important enough to @everyone?
answers.note: 先掂量重要性再决定，语气谨慎，适合怕打扰领导。

answers.en: I'm going to @everyone on this — okay?
answers.note: 已经决定只求确认，语气偏强势，适合事情确实紧急。

items.zh: 这个群一天几百条，你怎么看得过来？
items.scene: 午饭时跟同事聊工作群刷屏

answers.en: This group gets hundreds of messages a day — how do you keep up?
answers.note: 先摆事实再问，带点佩服，适合吃午饭时闲聊。

answers.en: How do you even read this group? It never stops.
answers.note: even 和 never stops 带抱怨，语气随意，适合同事吐槽。

answers.en: Do you actually read all of it, or just skim?
answers.note: 给出全看和略看两个选项，像真好奇对方习惯，适合熟人之间。

items.zh: 周末爬山照片发朋友圈了吗？
items.scene: 周一上班问同事周末活动

answers.en: Did you post the hiking photos from the weekend?
answers.note: 最直接，只问发没发，适合走廊里随口一问。

answers.en: Are the hiking pictures going up on your Moments?
answers.note: going up 很口语，指打算发，问的是接下来会不会发。

answers.en: I didn't see your hiking photos — did you post them?
answers.note: 先说没看到再问，暗示自己一直在等，适合关系好。

items.zh: 你朋友圈怎么只能看三天？
items.scene: 想翻朋友旧动态却发现看不了

answers.en: Why's your Moments set to three days?
answers.note: 直接问设置，语气中性，适合熟人之间随口一提。

answers.en: Is your Moments three-day only? I was trying to look back.
answers.note: 先确认设置再说明原因，语气委婉，不像在质问。

answers.en: Did you set your Moments to three days? I can't see anything older.
answers.note: 摆出自己看不到的事实，带点委屈，适合好朋友。

items.zh: 我发的朋友圈你看到了吗？怎么不点赞？
items.scene: 跟好朋友半开玩笑地追问

answers.en: Did you see my post? You didn't even like it.
answers.note: 直接点出没点赞，半开玩笑，适合好朋友互相打趣。

answers.en: I posted something — no like from you?
answers.note: no like from you 更俏皮，像故意找茬，适合损友。

answers.en: Did my post show up in your feed? I got nothing from you.
answers.note: 先怀疑对方没刷到，给对方台阶，适合不想显得计较。

items.zh: 饭钱我微信转你吧，多少来着？
items.scene: 吃完饭掏手机准备付账

answers.en: I'll send you the money on WeChat — how much was it again?
answers.note: 先讲付款方式再问金额，最常用，适合吃完饭随口说。

answers.en: What do I owe you? I'll just transfer it on WeChat.
answers.note: 先问欠多少再讲方式，语序反过来，是很口语的说法。

answers.en: I'll WeChat you the money — what's the damage?
answers.note: what's the damage 是问价钱的玩笑说法，适合朋友聚餐。

items.zh: 钱收到了吗？我这边显示已转出。
items.scene: 转账后对方没回，问一句

answers.en: Did the money go through? It shows as sent on my end.
answers.note: go through 指到账，先问结果再摆证据，语气中性。

answers.en: Can you check if my transfer came in?
answers.note: 请对方查一下，语气客气，适合跟不太熟的人。

answers.en: My app says it went out — did you get it?
answers.note: 先说 app 显示已转出，再问收到没，适合怕出岔子。

items.zh: 这次聚餐AA，我在群里发个收款吧？
items.scene: 聚餐结束，跟组织者商量怎么收钱

answers.en: Should I send a payment request to the group for the split?
answers.note: split 指平摊费用，说法清楚，适合跟组织者确认。

answers.en: Want me to collect everyone's share in the group chat?
answers.note: collect everyone's share 更口语，重点在谁去收钱。

answers.en: I'll throw a payment request in the group — we're splitting it, right?
answers.note: throw 很随意，顺带确认是不是 AA，适合朋友局。

items.zh: 打字太慢了，我发语音方便吗？
items.scene: 在地铁上想回一条长消息

answers.en: Typing's too slow — is it okay if I send voice messages?
answers.note: 先讲原因再征求同意，最完整，适合对方可能不方便听。

answers.en: Mind if I just send voice notes?
answers.note: Mind if 直接征求同意，最短，适合熟人之间。

answers.en: I'll send you a voice message — too much to type.
answers.note: 已经决定再说明，语气随意，适合关系近不用客气。

items.zh: 开会不方便听，你语音能转文字吗？
items.scene: 会议室里收到一条长语音

answers.en: I'm in a meeting — can you turn that voice message into text?
answers.note: 先说明场合再提请求，最得体，适合跟领导或客户说。

answers.en: Can't listen right now — mind typing it out?
answers.note: 请对方重打一遍，更直接，适合有急事要马上看。

answers.en: I can't listen right now — is it okay if I convert it?
answers.note: 问能不能转文字，最省事，适合对方不介意。

items.zh: 刚给你打视频怎么没接？
items.scene: 视频通话挂断后追问对方

answers.en: I just called you on video — why didn't you pick up?
answers.note: 最直接，带一点质问，适合关系很熟的朋友。

answers.en: Did my video call not go through?
answers.note: 先怀疑是技术问题，给对方一个台阶，适合不想显得责怪。

answers.en: Were you away from your phone? I tried video calling.
answers.note: 主动替对方找理由，语气最软，适合怕打扰到对方。

items.zh: 你那边是不是信号不好？画面一直卡。
items.scene: 视频通话中途画面卡顿

answers.en: Is your signal bad? The video keeps freezing.
answers.note: 先问原因再说现象，最常用，适合刚开始卡的时候。

answers.en: You're breaking up — can you hear me?
answers.note: breaking up 是口语说法，指通话断断续续，重点转到对方能否听见。

answers.en: Your video's frozen — should we switch to audio?
answers.note: 直接给出换语音的方案，最实用，适合一直卡。

items.zh: 刚那条发错了，你看到了吗？
items.scene: 撤回消息后心虚地问对方

answers.en: I sent that by mistake — did you see it?
answers.note: 先认错再问，最直接，适合内容不太敏感的时候。

answers.en: Did you catch that message before I unsent it?
answers.note: unsent 指撤回消息，问得更具体，适合较真。

answers.en: Please tell me you didn't see that.
answers.note: 用祈使句求对方没看到，带慌张，适合发错给领导。

items.zh: 我好像把消息发错群了，怎么办？
items.scene: 发现私聊内容发进工作群

answers.en: I think I sent that to the wrong group — what do I do?
answers.note: 最直白，带求助，适合马上找人商量怎么办。

answers.en: Did I just send that to the work group?
answers.note: 用反问确认，带不敢相信，适合刚发现的那一秒。

answers.en: I messed up — that message went to the work group.
answers.note: 先认错再陈述，语气更沉，适合向领导汇报。

items.zh: 他天天刷屏，我要不要屏蔽他朋友圈？
items.scene: 跟室友吐槽某个好友动态太多

answers.en: He posts nonstop — should I hide his Moments?
answers.note: hide his Moments 指不再看他的动态，语气中性，适合征求意见。

answers.en: Is it worth hiding his posts?
answers.note: 问值不值得屏蔽，带权衡，适合还在犹豫的人。

answers.en: I can't take his posts anymore — should I just hide them?
answers.note: 先说自己受不了再问，带情绪，适合跟室友吐槽。

items.zh: 这个群能不能设成免打扰？
items.scene: 晚上被群消息吵醒，问家人怎么弄

answers.en: Can I mute this group?
answers.note: 最短，直接问操作，适合问身边懂手机的人。

answers.en: Is there a way to turn off notifications for this group?
answers.note: 完整问法，语气客气，适合问不熟的人或客服。

answers.en: How do I silence this group at night?
answers.note: 点明只想晚上安静，问具体怎么弄，适合家里人。

items.zh: 过年了，我在群里发个红包吧？
items.scene: 除夕夜家族群里问长辈

answers.en: It's New Year's — should I send a red packet to the group?
answers.note: 先点节日再提议，最完整，适合在家族群里问长辈。

answers.en: Want me to drop a red packet in the family group?
answers.note: drop 很口语，像随手发一个，适合平辈之间。

answers.en: I'll send a red packet — how much is normal?
answers.note: 已经决定，顺带问行情，适合头一次发红包的人。

items.zh: 你抢到多少？我才抢了两块钱。
items.scene: 群里发红包后跟朋友比金额

answers.en: How much did you get? I only got two yuan.
answers.note: 最直接，一问一答，适合在群里刚抢完红包。

answers.en: I only got two yuan — did you do any better?
answers.note: 先报自己的金额再反问对方，语气随意，适合好朋友比手气。

answers.en: Did you get more than me? I only got two yuan.
answers.note: 直接比谁多，像打趣，适合关系随便的朋友。

items.zh: 红包发多少合适？同事结婚。
items.scene: 同事结婚，问家人微信红包包多少

answers.en: How much should I put in the red packet? A coworker's getting married.
answers.note: 最直白，先问金额再补背景，适合问家里人。

answers.en: What's a normal amount for a wedding red packet?
answers.note: 问当下行情，语气中性，适合不想失礼又怕多给。

answers.en: Is 500 too much for a coworker's wedding?
answers.note: 先报一个数让对方判断，语气犹豫，适合心里没底时。

items.zh: 你这个表情包哪来的？发我一下。
items.scene: 聊天时看中对方的表情包

answers.en: Where'd you get that sticker? Send it to me.
answers.note: 最直接，先问来源再开口要，适合熟人之间。

answers.en: That sticker's great — can you send it over?
answers.note: 先夸一句再要，语气客气，适合不太熟的朋友。

answers.en: I need that sticker in my life. Send it.
answers.note: 夸张说法带玩笑，像在耍赖，适合损友之间。

items.zh: 他老用表情包回我，是不是不想聊？
items.scene: 跟朋友分析相亲对象的聊天习惯

answers.en: He keeps replying with stickers — does that mean he's not into it?
answers.note: 先摆现象再问意思，最适合找朋友帮忙分析。

answers.en: Is he just being polite? It's all stickers from him.
answers.note: 先猜结论再补证据，语气更怀疑，适合已经起疑。

answers.en: Do guys use stickers when they're done talking?
answers.note: 把问题问成普遍现象，像在取经，适合问闺蜜。
